name: Navidrome
description: Standalone server that allows you to browse and listen to your music collection using a web browser or any Subsonic-compatible client.

connection.title: Set up Navidrome
connection.description: Your standalone music server is running.

firstLogin.note: The first user to log in will create the administrative account. You can then upload music directly into the 'navidrome_music' volume via SFTP or your host terminal.

features.title: Subsonic Compatible
features.description: Stream your music to any client supporting the Subsonic API.

features.title: Resource Efficient
features.description: Written in Go, Navidrome uses minimal RAM and CPU, making it perfect for self-hosting.
